summary: Short kerb at Mitre Street's top end beside a building site; apartments 19 m away.
reasons: Level, but close to main road

best_section.where: West kerb at the Mitre Street entrance off the main road, beside the building site

drivers.seclusion: Mapped building site 7 m away (non-residential); La Fayette apartments 19 m away on the same side, more homes opposite.
drivers.access_and_room: Open street with cars parked along the kerb; room for one van length.
drivers.traffic: Street mouth beside a busy main road, with vehicles turning in.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but 1P and 2P signs and a weekday 4-6:30pm no-stopping sign apply.

flags: Dwelling 19 m away on the same side
Main-road noise at the street mouth
sun_shade: Open; the tall building to the west shades the kerb in the afternoon.
